name: Single-pass GPU Solid Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to voxelize solid geometry in a single pass, producing point-sampled or over/under-conservative results.
summary: Single-pass GPU Solid Voxelization is a GPU algorithm that produces fully filled interior volumes in one pass, differing from boundary-only methods by filling interiors and from multi-pass methods by extracting up to 1024 layers at once.
